Description: Verify user can log in with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page 2. Enter username and password 3. Click Login button
Expected Result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to dashboard

Description: Test the search functionality for products
Steps: 1. Go to homepage 2. Enter product name in search box 3. Click search button 4. Review results
Expected Result: Relevant products are displayed in search results

Description: Verify items can be added to shopping cart
Steps: 1. Search for a product 2. Click on product details 3. Select quantity 4. Click Add to Cart
Expected Result: Product is added to cart with correct quantity

Steps: 1. Click Register link 2. Fill in all required fields 3. Accept terms and conditions 4. Submit form
Expected Result: New account is created and confirmation email is sent

Steps: 1. Click Forgot Password 2. Enter email address 3. Check email for reset link 4. Follow link and enter new password
Expected Result: Password is successfully reset and user can login with new password
